title: Feedback that lands: a practice from Communication
description:
Say what happened, the impact it had, and what different would look like. Close to the event, in private, assuming they want to be good.

Try it:
1. Deliver one piece of real feedback: what happened, the impact, what different looks like.
2. Ask a colleague: “what's one thing I do that makes your work harder?”
3. Say thank you. Sit with it for a day.
